newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares extend gains by close.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares extend gains by close.

text.p: Vilniaus Bank, Hermis Bank and Rokishkis Cheese kept Lithuania's stock exchange busy again on Wednesday, helping the market to healthy gains by the close.
The blue-chip official list gained 28.29 points to 1093.44 points, while the broader group-A index eased 1.79 points to 1838.50 points.
Central market turnover inched up to 1.5 million litas from one million litas.
As Vilniaus Bank rose to 300 litas from 280 litas in central market turnover of 91,000, dealers said the country's largest bank may make further gains.
"I think there is still room for Vilniaus Bank to grow," said one broker.
Vilniaus Bank could make it to 310 litas this week or next and hold in a range around there until the next round of financial results poured in, he added.
Vilniaus Bank also saw 93,000 litas worth of block trades at 300 litas.
Rokishkis advanced to 47 litas from 46 litas in good 850,000 litas central market turnover. Some 188,000 litas of block trades at prices from 46.78 litas to 47 litas was also done.
Brokers say the market was slow to respond to Rokishkis's solid six-month results, but, like Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank, Rokishkis is now having a run .
"We expect the (Rokishkis) price to move up to 50 litas soon, maybe in the next week or two," one trader said.
Hermis Bank held steady at 265 litas and saw a healthy 326,000 litas on the central market and another 265,000 litas worth of block trades at 265 litas.
